s.note: the party where Lloyd keeps everyone's car keys
s.how: Cook 3 sliced onions slowly in butter for 40 minutes until deep golden. Cool and fold through 300ml sour cream and 125g cream cheese with snipped chives. Chill and serve with a bowl of potato chips and a bowl of pretzels.

s.note: rainy Seattle, where Lloyd and Diane live
s.how: Flake 200g hot-smoked salmon and fold through 200g cream cheese with chopped dill, lemon zest and a spoon of capers. Spread thickly on rye crispbread and finish each with a squeeze of lemon. Serve cold on a Seattle kind of grey afternoon.

m.how: Spread 4 salmon fillets with Dijon and press on breadcrumbs mixed with parsley and lemon zest. Roast at 220C for 10 minutes. Boil 800g potatoes, crush with butter and salt. Steam green beans and toss with butter to serve alongside.

w.how: Toss 500g mixed berries with 50g sugar and a squeeze of lemon and spread in a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g oats, 100g flour and 80g sugar and scatter over. Bake at 180C for 35 minutes until bubbling and serve with vanilla ice cream.

d.how: Grind beans fresh and set a paper filter in a cone over a jug. Pour freshly boiled water slowly in circles over the grounds, waiting between pours. Serve in big mugs with a splash of hot milk on a rainy afternoon in Seattle.
